mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a generalised view of man and an inflexible explanation of what motivates people."

Moral involvement is an intense, committed, and strongly favourable form of involvement or identification with an organisation and its goals.

Power is the ability or capacity to exercise control over others against their own will.

Calculative involvement is an economic - instrumental involvement whereby an individual participates voluntarily in an organisation for the benefits which he expects to get from his membership of the organisation.

An organisation is a closed system when only its internal environment is considered.
